step0.title: Welcome to the first expedition!
step0.content: We have opened the temple doors for the first time. Get ready to explore this new productivity environment and help us polish every corner.

step1.title: Break down your missions
step1.content: Here you will structure your success. Organize your tasks to the millimeter by creating detailed hierarchies so not even the smallest detail escapes you.

step2.title: Tasks are the core
step2.content: Define your estimated times, deadlines, and earnings. Use them well, keep control of your deliverables, and make every hour count.

step3.title: Time to Act!
step3.content: Time is gold on the expedition. Create your first project, add a task with its estimate, and start logging your activity.

step4.title: Times under control
step4.content: Your temporal control tower. Use this central view to manage all your events, reminders, and commitments connected to the ecosystem.

step5.title: Side planning
step5.content: Quickly check upcoming events and filter key dates to stay ahead of any obstacles in your path.

step6.title: Shape the environment
step6.content: Analyze your actual effectiveness. Just like the home dashboard, here you can organize your metrics to fit your workflow.

step7.title: The Inner Sanctuary
step7.content: Cross the threshold into Temple Mode. Your sanctuary of productivity to isolate yourself from all outside noise.

step8.title: Deep focus
step8.content: Plunge into a state of maximum concentration with this integrated timer for your most intense work sessions.

step9.title: Leave your mark
step9.content: Customize your experience to the max. Come here to configure your personal details, upload your avatar, and try out the amazing Maya Theme.
